title: Fourier square functional of an average
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $c(S)\ge 0$ for every subset $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and let $\{f_i\}_{i\in I}$ be a nonempty finite family of real-valued functions on the sign cube. The weighted sum of squared Fourier coefficients of the pointwise uniform average $|I|^{-1}\sum_{i\in I} f_i$ is at most the uniform average of the corresponding weighted sums for the individual functions.
hypotheses_covered: Each $f_i$ is real-valued on the sign cube
